snippet.title: ₹5,000 करोड़ लेकर Birla ने Tanishq पर हमला क्यों किया?
snippet.description:
For nearly three decades, Tanishq has built one of the strongest trust-based jewellery businesses in India.

Then Kumar Mangalam Birla entered the market.

With a planned investment of ₹5,000 crore, Aditya Birla Group launched Indriya and expanded rapidly across India.

But this battle is not simply about opening more jewellery stores.

The real question is much deeper:

Can money and speed break 30 years of customer trust?

In this video, we break down the complete business battle between Birla’s Indriya and Tata’s Tanishq.

We explore how Tanishq originally built its jewellery empire by solving one of the biggest problems in the Indian gold market — trust.

From purity testing and the Karatmeter to old-gold exchange and transparent pricing, Tanishq gave customers a reason to move away from traditional jewellers.

Years later, Birla is now using a similar weapon.

A significant share of Indriya’s sales is coming from old-gold exchange, which means the company is not only trying to sell new jewellery — it is trying to bring customers from existing jewellers into its own ecosystem.

But getting the first purchase is only the beginning.

Jewellery is a high-trust business.

Customers think about purity, resale value, exchange, family approval and whether they can confidently return to the same brand years later.

That is where Tanishq’s decades-long head start matters.

The video also explains the hidden economics of the jewellery business — inventory rotation, gold prices, store productivity, customer repeat rates and why rapid expansion does not automatically create a strong business moat.

snippet.title: Saksi Express: November 24, 2026 [HD]
snippet.description:
Narito ang mga balitang ating sinaksihan ngayong Martes November 24, 2026.


- P4 na rollback sa kada kilo ng LPG, epektibo na bukas
- 3 Vietnamese national, arestado dahil sa pagsasagawa umano ng liposuction nang walang permit
- Suspek sa pamamaril sa nakaalitan niyang may-ari ng aso, sumuko
- Atong Ang, inisyuhan ng panibagong arrest warrant kaugnay sa pagkawala ng 6 na sabungero sa Manila Arena noong 2022
- Ilang senador, naalarma sa tila pagbabanta ni Trump nang sabihin nitong sa Amerika na kukuha ang Pilipinas ng 100% ng kailangan nitong energy at agri imports
- Habeas corpus petition ng mga anak ni FPRRD na kumuwestiyon sa pag-aresto sa kanya, ibinasura ng Korte Suprema
- Desisyon ng SC kaugnay ng petisyon ng magkakapatid na Duterte, nirerespeto raw ni Atty. Torreon pero 'di sila sang-ayon
- Pahayag ni Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano tungkol sa ambagan para bayaran ang national debt, umani ng samu't saring reaksyon
- Multi-domain equipment at kinetic weaponry, nakatakdang bilhin ng Pilipinas sa Amerika; tingin ng analyst: tila may pinaghahandaan
- Pahirapang pagbiyahe papunta sa tourist destinations ng bansa, inireklamo ng ilang senador
- Ex-Rep. Mike Defensor at Joseph Espiritu, aapela sa pagbasura sa hiling na makapagpiyansa; Sen. Rodante Marcoleta at legal team, mag-uusap pa
- Frat brod ni ex-Speaker Romualdez, front lang umano sa mga korporasyon at ari-ariang pinondohan ng kickback mula sa flood control scheme, ayon sa testigo
- PBBM at Alex Eala, nagkaharap sa tennis game
- Supermoon o "Beaver Moon" na mukhang mas malaki at mas maliwanag, inabangan at nasilayan sa iba't ibang lugar

శంకర్ ధాబాకి వచ్చిన పల్లెటూరి తాత రౌడీ ఫ్రీగా పకాళి అన్నం దోసె కావాలని అడిగాడు.

శంకర్ ప్రేమగా దోసె చేసి పెట్టాడు. తిన్న తర్వాత తాత రౌడీకి ఎంత నచ్చిందో తెలుసా? ఇంకొకటి తన ఆవిడ కోసం పార్సిల్ అడిగాడు.

ఈ ఫన్నీ ఎపిసోడ్ చివరి వరకు చూడండి.
